## Findings

1. Q4 (blocking for C5). The spec says quoted originals follow Spark's format, but no sample of that format exists. Builder correctly refused to guess. Proposed route: Scott sends one reply and one forward from Spark on mcptest@reasinger.net to sreasinger@gmail.com; the verifier pulls the raw received copies through the Gmail connector into `docs/build/samples/` as the reference. The format is then built in C5 against those samples.
2. Q5 and Q6 are non-blocking; the builder's defaults are sound (see recommendations to Scott). Because they state behavior the spec does not, the answers go into spec v1.4 with Q4.
3. Limit, accepted: REQ-14-10 compares the server signature to the gatekeeper-panel line as recorded in the source pack. A later edit to the live skill will not be detected by this test. The SKILL chunk must re-check it at cutover.
4. Builder choices reviewed and accepted: raw HTML passes through CommonMark; one blank line between body and signature with no `-- ` delimiter; `From` is the bare address; `Fwd:` always added (REQ-9-16's only-if-absent rule is for `Re:`); non-ASCII display names encoded; MIME nesting capped at 20; fixed boundary that quoted-printable cannot produce.
